messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] how to download the the affymetrix file "mapping10k_xba142.cdf"
parts:
Hi,

I notice a few days ago that Affymetrix have updated their website,
which is good news. But I also noticed that a lot of the links we
have to them are now broken. I tried to find the Support Materials
for the Mapping 10K chip types, but I can neither find them. I've
email support[-at-]affymetrix[-dot-]com about the problem.

I do have local copies of several CDFs, but legally I don't feel
comfortable posting them online. However, a quick search on Google
will actual lead you to an Affymetrix page for easy access of most
CDFs. Try for instance to search for "site:www.affymetrix.com
Mapping10K_Xba142.CDF index"

Hope this helps

/Henrik

Affymetrix support got back to me and they'll create a page for
accessing "retired" chip type data. I got no time frame on this, but

/Henrik
